title: CWP/4802/2005 of HARBHAJAN KAUR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB & ORS.
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 455-A CWP-4802-2005 (O&M) Date of decision: 07.03.2025 Harbhajan Kaur … Petitioner Vs. State of Punjab and others … Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present : Dr. MS Rahi, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Swapan Shorey, DAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (ORAL)

1. Prayer made in the present petition is for directing the respondents to decide the representation dated 04.12.2003, reminder thereof and representation dated 10.11.2004.

2. A perusal of the reply filed by respondent No.3 reveals that amounts have already been paid to the petitioner, which had not been controverted by filing any replication, relevant paras whereof read thus:- “4. That the contents of para-4 are again false, as the salary shown in the statement given in this Hon'ble Court is Rs.7,531/- and after deducting Rs.455/- towards the contribution of provident fund, net of Rs.7,076 was paid to the petitioner and, as such, nothing more is to be paid to the petitioner employee,

5. That the salary shown in the statement given in this Court is Rs.7,711/- and after deducting the salary for one day on account of leave without pay, i.e. Rs.249/-, a sum of Rs.7,462/- has been correctly paid to the petitioner As such, nothing more is required to be paid to her.

6. That the salary shown in the statement given to this Court for the month April, 2004, is Rs.7,803/- and after deducting one day salary, i.e. Rs.257/- on account of leave without pay, a sum of Rs.7,546/- was correctly paid to the petitioner and the same has been audited in the annual audit and found correct.

7. That the salary shown in the statement given to this Court for the month December, 2004 is Rs.7,803/- and after deducting three days salary, i.e. Rs.755/- on account of leave without pay, a sum of Rs.7,048/- was correctly paid to the petitioner and the same has been audited in the annual audit and found correct. xx xx

9. That the petitioner was entitled to a sum of Rs.62,598/- being the arrears of difference from January, 1996 to March, 1999. BT (Pension Fund) of Rs.12,141/- was deducted and a sum of Rs.50,457/- has been paid to her, i.e. Rs.28,536/- (Rs.4756 x 6) were given earlier and remaining Rs.21,918/- was included in the revised payment of Rs.1,04,320/-. Thus every penny has been paid to the petitioner.

10. That the General provident fund statement of the petitioner for the period April 1998 to March, 1999 at the rate of Rs.146/- per month i.e. 146 x 12 = Rs.1752/- Details of GP Fund Period Rate per Month Total month amount April, 1999 to March, 2000 Rs.516/- 12 6,192/- April, 2000 to March, 2001 Rs.532/- 12 6,384/- April, 2001 to March, 2002 Rs.548/- 12 6,576/- April, 2002 to March, 2003 Rs.564/- 12 6,768/- April, 2003 to March, 2004 Rs.580/- 12 6,960/- April, 2004 to March, 2005 Rs.600/- 12 7,200/- April, 2005 to March, 2006 Rs.620/- 12 7,440/- Total 47,520.00

3. Disposed of, however, reserving the petitioner with a liberty to represent to the said respondents by filing a representation, in case, any grievance still subsists and if filed within a period of 4 weeks, the same shall be decided, expeditiously, in accordance with law, which satisfies the learned counsel for the petitioner. 07.03.2025 (AMAN CHAUDHARY) ashok JUDGE
